meaning: a number is asserted or relayed with nothing durable to check it against
scope: F1 `NAME = digits` (after fullwidth-`=` normalisation), F2 relay wording, and F3 ANY bare numeric claim (>=3 digits, or digits + a unit/counter word) -- all judged against the same durable-coordinate window; structural ids (ORD-####, Q#, `x-1`, HH:MM) are not claims
